name: bc-speculation-vacancy-tax
description: Review British Columbia Speculation and Vacancy Tax for individual residential property owners in designated areas. Establish calendar-year ownership, assessed value, specified Canadian/BC status, prior-year household income, exemptions, ownership share, current rates and credits, declaration/payment, late assessment and referral. Separate calendar2026 SVT from the2025-2026 declaration cycle, Vancouver Empty Homes Tax and historic federal UHT. Do not charge or file federal UHT for2025onward. Entity/trust/partnership, contested status and appeal cases require the specific specialist workpaper.
